SELECT A.FAQ_SEQ ,A.HOSP_CD ,A.FILE_GB ,A.QSTN_CONTS ,A.QSTN_CONTS AS QSTN_CONTS1 ,A.ANSR_CONTS ,A.ANSR_CONTS AS ANSR_CONTS1 ,B.USER_NM ,IFNULL(A.START_DT,'') START_DT ,IFNULL(A.END_DT,'') END_DT ,A.USE_YN ,A.SORT_SEQ ,A.REG_DTTM ,A.REG_USER ,A.REG_IP ,A.UPD_DTTM ,A.UPD_USER ,A.UPD_IP FROM TBL_FAQ_MST A LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_MST B ON B.HOSP_CD = A.HOSP_CD AND B.USER_ID = A.UPD_USER AND B.ACTION_YN = A.ACTION_YN WHERE A.ACTION_YN = 'Y'
AND (A.QSTN_CONTS LIKE CONCAT('%',#{qstnConts},'%') OR A.ANSR_CONTS LIKE CONCAT('%',#{ansrConts},'%') )
ORDER BY A.UPD_DTTM DESC
SELECT 'Y' FROM TBL_FAQ_MST WHERE 1=1 AND FAQ_SEQ = #{faqSeq} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y'

SELECT NOTI_SEQ, FILE_GB, START_DT, END_DT, USE_YN, HOSP_CD, NOTI_TITLE, NOTI_CONTENT, UPDATE_SW, NOTI_REDCNT, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP, UPD_DTTM, UPD_USER, UPD_IP, JOB_SEQ, ACTION_YN FROM TBL_NOTI_MST WHERE NOTI_SEQ = #{notiSeq}

SELECT A.FILE_SEQ ,A.FILE_GB ,A.FILE_TITLE ,A.FILE_PATH ,A.HOSP_CD ,A.USE_YN ,A.REG_DTTM ,A.REG_USER ,A.REG_IP ,A.UPD_DTTM ,A.UPD_USER ,A.UPD_IP ,B.SUB_CODE_NM ,A.FILE_SIZE FROM TBL_FILE_MST A LEFT JOIN TBL_CODE_DTL B ON B.CODE_GB = 'Z' AND B.CODE_CD = 'NOTI_GB' AND B.SUB_CODE = A.FILE_GB AND B.ACTION_YN = A.ACTION_YN WHERE 1=1 AND A.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND A.FILE_SEQ = #{fileSeq} AND A.FILE_GB = #{fileGb}
AND A.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}

SELECT A.HOSP_CD, A.FILE_GB, A.QSTN_TITLE, A.ASQ_SEQ , IFNULL(B.USER_NM,'') USER_NM , C.HOSP_NM , A.QSTN_CONTS, A.ASQ_SHARE, IFNULL(A.ANSR_CONTS,'') ANSR_CONTS , A.UPDATE_SW, A.REG_DTTM, A.REG_USER, A.REG_IP, A.READ_CNT , A.UPD_DTTM, A.UPD_USER, A.UPD_IP, A.QSTN_WAN , A.ANSR_WAN , CASE WHEN A.QSTN_WAN = 'Y' THEN '질문완료' ELSE '질문대기' END QSTN_STAT , CASE WHEN A.ANSR_WAN = 'Y' THEN '답변완료' ELSE '답변대기' END ANSR_STAT , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_FILE_MST F WHERE F.FILE_SEQ = A.ASQ_SEQ AND F.FILE_GB IN ('4','5') AND F.ACTION_YN = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FILE_YN FROM TBL_ASQ_MST A LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_MST B ON B.USER_ID = A.REG_USER AND B.HOSP_CD = A.HOSP_CD AND B.ACTION_YN = A.ACTION_YN LEFT JOIN TBL_HOSP_MST C ON C.HOSP_CD = A.HOSP_CD AND C.ACTION_YN = A.ACTION_YN WHERE 1=1 AND A.ACTION_YN = 'Y'
AND A.HOSP_cd = #{hospCd}
AND IFNULL(A.ANSR_WAN,'') != 'Y'
AND IFNULL(A.ANSR_WAN,'') = 'Y'
AND (A.QSTN_TITLE LIKE CONCAT(#{qstnTitle},'%') OR A.QSTN_CONTS LIKE CONCAT(#{qstnTitle},'%') )
Order by A.ANSR_WAN ASC , A.UPD_DTTM DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_ASQ_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND ANSR_WAN = 'Y' AND IFNULL(ANSR_READ_YN,'N') = 'N' AND ACTION_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update:
UPDATE TBL_ASQ_MST SET ANSR_READ_YN = 'Y' WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND ANSR_WAN = 'Y' AND IFNULL(ANSR_READ_YN,'N') = 'N' AND ACTION_YN = 'Y'
AND ASQ_SEQ = #{asqSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT QSTN_TITLE , QSTN_CONTS , IFNULL(QSTN_WAN,'') QSTN_WAN , ANSR_CONTS , IFNULL(ANSR_WAN,'') ANSR_WAN , UPDATE_SW , FILE_GB , ASQ_SEQ , REG_DTTM , REG_USER , REG_IP , UPD_DTTM , UPD_USER , UPD_IP FROM TBL_ASQ_MST WHERE ASQ_SEQ = #{asqSeq} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert:
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
INSERT INTO TBL_ASQ_MST ( HOSP_CD, FILE_GB, QSTN_TITLE, QSTN_CONTS, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP, UPD_DTTM, UPD_USER, UPD_IP, QSTN_WAN , JOB_SEQ , ACTION_YN ) VALUES ( #{hospCd2}, #{fileGb2}, #{qstnTitle}, #{qstnConts}, NOW(), #{regUser}, #{regIp}, NOW(), #{updUser}, #{updIp}, #{qstnWan}, (SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(A.JOB_SEQ) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(A.JOB_SEQ) + 1 ELSE 1 END FROM TBL_ASQ_MST A WHERE A.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd2} AND A.FILE_GB = #{fileGb2} ) , 'Y' )
mapper.select:
SELECT SEQ ,HOSP_NM ,JONG_NM ,BED_CNT ,CONSULT_GB1 ,CONSULT_GB2 ,CONSULT_GB3 ,CONSULT_GB4 ,CONSULT_GB5 ,CONSULT_GITA1 ,CONSULT_GITA2 ,CONSULT_GITA3 ,USER_NM ,USER_POSI ,USER_PHONE ,ACCPET_YN ,ACTION_YN ,COMFORM_YN ,REG_DTTM ,UPD_DTTM FROM TBL_VISITASQ_MST WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y'
AND (HOSP_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{findData},'%') OR USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{findData},'%') OR USER_PHONE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{findData},'%'))
ORDER BY SEQ DESC

SELECT C.CAT_ID AS catId ,C.P_CAT_ID AS pCatId ,C.CAT_NM AS catNm ,C.CAT_DESC AS catDesc ,C.SRC_TYPE AS srcType ,C.SORT_NO AS sortNo ,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_QNA_KB K WHERE K.USE_YN = 'Y' AND ( (C.P_CAT_ID IS NULL AND K.CAT_ID = C.CAT_ID) OR (C.P_CAT_ID IS NOT NULL AND K.SUB_ID = C.CAT_ID) ) ) AS qCnt FROM TBL_QNA_CAT C WHERE C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY IFNULL(C.P_CAT_ID,C.CAT_ID), (C.P_CAT_ID IS NOT NULL), C.SORT_NO

SELECT K.KB_ID AS kbId ,K.KB_CODE AS kbCode ,IFNULL(NULLIF(K.SHORT_TITLE,''),K.TITLE) AS title ,K.CAT_ID AS catId ,K.SRC_TYPE AS srcType ,K.HIT_CNT AS hitCnt ,K.TOP_NO AS topNo ,C.CAT_NM AS catNm FROM TBL_QNA_KB K LEFT JOIN TBL_QNA_CAT C ON C.CAT_ID = K.CAT_ID WHERE K.USE_YN = 'Y' AND K.TOP_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY K.TOP_NO, K.KB_ID LIMIT #{topCnt}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QNA_KB (KB_CODE, CAT_ID, SRC_TYPE, KIND, TITLE, BODY, WEIGHT, USE_YN, TOP_YN, TOP_NO) VALUES (#{kbCode}, #{catId}, 'WNN', 'HTML', #{title}, #{body}, 5, 'Y', 'Y', #{topNo})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_QNA_KB SET USE_YN = 'N', TOP_YN = 'N' WHERE KB_ID = #{kbId}
UPDATE TBL_QNA_KB SET TOP_YN = 'N' WHERE KB_ID = #{kbId}
UPDATE TBL_QNA_KB SET TOP_YN = 'Y', TOP_NO = #{topNo} WHERE KB_ID = #{kbId}
mapper.select: SELECT K.KB_ID AS kbId ,K.KB_CODE AS kbCode ,K.TITLE AS title FROM TBL_QNA_KB K WHERE K.USE_YN = 'Y' AND FIND_IN_SET(K.KB_CODE, #{relIds}) > 0 ORDER BY FIND_IN_SET(K.KB_CODE, #{relIds})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_QNA_KB SET HIT_CNT = HIT_CNT + 1 WHERE KB_ID = #{kbId}
